span.p:
get_large() — gameplay
get_small() — mechanical
Model-agnostic tiers (ADR 003).
Three providers behind them (ADR 009/013):
Bedrock Nova (nova-pro / nova-lite, us-east-1),
Bedrock Claude, and local Ollama.
NO Claude in the default gameplay path.
